name: Kirihara Erisa
source: A half-Japanese half-European girl with blonde hair. She is a confidant dancer that exudes beauty, style, and talent. She is prideful and makes her opinion known, but has a hidden masochistic side. She is a professional with her fans, always ready with a smile.
translation: A half-Japanese half-European girl with blonde hair. She is a confidant dancer that exudes beauty, style, and talent. She is prideful and makes her opinion known, but has a hidden masochistic side. She is a professional with her fans, always ready with a smile.
